Test Description: This test performs PCIe device enumeration by initializing link training for dual-mode controllers in x4 configuration, programming cache coherency settings in the COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF register for both PCIe port 0 and port 1, polling the gic register on SII0 and SII1 interfaces until link status is confirmed, reading the Vendor ID from TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG, enabling memory and bus master via TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG, programming memory base addresses, configuring system-level control registers, disabling cache coherency, enumerating BAR registers (BAR0_REG, BAR1_REG, SEC_LAT_TIMER_SUB_BUS_SEC_BUS_PRI_BUS_REG, SEC_STAT_IO_LIMIT_IO_BASE_REG, MEM_LIMIT_MEM_BASE_REG, PREF_MEM_LIMIT_PREF_MEM_BASE_REG) on both slave ports by writing all-ones to determine BAR sizes and then programming specific base addresses, and finally polling a synchronization register until a completion handshake value is received.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Initialize the system control register to clear any previous state. 2. Perform PCIe link training for dual-mode controllers in x4 lane configuration based on the configured role (Root Complex or Endpoint). 3. Program cache coherency settings in the COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF register for both PCIe port 0 and port 1 by setting specific bit fields to enable coherency. 4. Wait for coherency settings to take effect. 5. Re-apply cache coherency programming for both ports with all relevant bit fields enabled. 6. Poll the gic register on the SII0 interface until the link status indicates ready (specific status bits confirmed). 7. Configure non-secure protection via NIC. 8. Poll the gic register on the SII1 interface until the link status indicates ready. 9. Read the device Vendor ID from TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG on slave port 0 to confirm device presence. 10. Write to TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG on slave port 0 to enable memory space access and bus mastering. 11. Program memory base addresses for both dual-mode controllers. 12. Enable system-level control registers by writing enable values. 13. Disable cache coherency by clearing the relevant bit fields in COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for both PCIe port 0 and port 1. 14. Wait for cache disable to take effect. 15. Enumerate BAR registers on slave port 1: write all-ones to BAR0_REG through PREF_MEM_LIMIT_PREF_MEM_BASE_REG to determine BAR sizes, read back, then program specific base addresses and read back to verify. 16. Enumerate BAR registers on slave port 0: repeat the same BAR sizing and address programming procedure. 17. Poll the synchronization register until the expected completion handshake value is received, confirming enumeration success. 18. Complete the test.
Impacted Registers: COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF; gic; TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG; TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG; BAR0_REG; BAR1_REG; SEC_LAT_TIMER_SUB_BUS_SEC_BUS_PRI_BUS_REG; SEC_STAT_IO_LIMIT_IO_BASE_REG; MEM_LIMIT_MEM_BASE_REG; PREF_MEM_LIMIT_PREF_MEM_BASE_REG
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: 1. The gic register on SII0 must return a value where the masked bits match the expected link-ready pattern before proceeding. 2. The gic register on SII1 must similarly confirm link readiness. 3. The TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG must return a valid Vendor ID confirming device presence on the PCIe bus. 4. BAR registers (BAR0_REG, BAR1_REG, SEC_LAT_TIMER_SUB_BUS_SEC_BUS_PRI_BUS_REG, SEC_STAT_IO_LIMIT_IO_BASE_REG, MEM_LIMIT_MEM_BASE_REG, PREF_MEM_LIMIT_PREF_MEM_BASE_REG) on both slave ports must respond correctly to all-ones writes for BAR sizing and must retain programmed base address values on read-back. 5. The synchronization register must eventually return the expected completion handshake value, confirming that the remote endpoint has completed its enumeration sequence. 6. The test passes when finish is called with a success code of 0.
Remarks: Test uses conditional compilation (DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP) to select link training mode; multiple wait_on delays are used between cache programming phases; polling loops on SII0 and SII1 interfaces have no explicit timeout and may block indefinitely if link does not come up; the final synchronization poll also has no timeout guard; several system-level register addresses could not be mapped to named registers; the PCIE1 coherency control register macro could not be resolved from available headers; the code block appears duplicated in the source file suggesting possible copy-paste in the original test.
